summary: More module defaults groups (acme from community.crypto, docker from community.general and community.docker, ovirt, vmware from community.vmware); check a collection's meta/runtime.yml for group members, and reference a group in module_defaults with the group/ prefix, for example group/aws.
questions: How do I reference a module group in module_defaults?
How do I find which modules are in a module defaults group?
Is there a module defaults group for docker?
